title: Persian Plural Nouns (-ها / -ان)
summary: How to make nouns plural in Persian.
explanation: The suffix '-ها' (ha) is used for all nouns. The suffix '-ان' (an) is mainly for animate objects.

example_translations.ex_fa_pl_1: The books are on the table.

common_error_explanations.err_fa_pl_1: Do not use '-ان' for non-living objects like books.
